R-security-1 (GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Insecure direct object reference (CWE-639 / CWE-862). Any signed-in user of organization 7 who sends `GET /invoices/42` receives invoice 42 even when it belongs to another organization: the query selects by id alone and the handler never calls `currentUser(req)`. Scope the query to the caller's organization (`WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2` with `[id, currentUser(req).orgId]`), answer 404 when nothing matches so ids of other organizations are not confirmed, and add a test that a foreign invoice id returns 404.
findings.title: GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice

findings.recommendation: Any request that makes a handler fail — for example a database error raised by `pg` (connection string host, relation or column names, constraint details) — returns the raw message and the full stack trace (file paths, dependency versions) to the caller (CWE-209). Keep `console.error(err)` for the server log and answer a generic body such as `{ error: "internal error" }` without `stack` or `err.message`.
findings.title: Error handler sends the error message and stack trace to the client
